rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is permitted or recognised by law.

example.english: This contract is lawful, so signing it gives you legal protection.
example.traditional: 呢份合約係合法嘅，簽咗就有法律保障。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 hai6 hap6 faat3 ge3 cim1 zo2 zau6 jau5 faat3 leot6 bou2 zoeng3

rows.meaning: according to a law or principle
rows.note: Use this when “lawful” means governed by a natural or fundamental principle rather than permitted by legislation.

example.english: This phenomenon is lawful, the result of a natural law.
example.traditional: 呢個現象合乎法則，係自然規律嘅結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jin6 zoeng6 hap6 fu1 faat3 zak1 hai6 zi6 jin4 kwai1 leot6 ge3 git3 gwo2
